title: Few Americans Say They Are Asking AI Chatbots for 2026 Election Information
summary_en: Among the 8% of U.S. adults using chatbots for this purpose, most have sought information about candidates or issues in the elections.

title: Growing Share of Americans Say Social Media Is an Important News Source for Them
summary_en: A majority of U.S. adults (58%) now say social media is an important way for them to keep up with the news.
title_cn: Growing Share of Americans Say Social Media Is an Important News Source for Them
